Create one premium editorial image for Brand Name Design.
Create a realistic editorial photoshoot image with an AI-generated model wearing the exact referenced garment. The garment graphic, silhouette, color, and product identity must follow the provided product/campaign references.
Use the provided reference images as the source of truth. Do not invent new garments, graphics, products, colorways, logos, or readable text.
When multiple reference images show the same product, synthesize the garment identity across all of them: front, back, close detail, fabric, color, fit, and graphic placement.
If the selected product has a minimal front logo, chest mark, hem mark, tag, grommet, or other small front-side branding/detail in the references, preserve it visibly on front-facing model shots.
Small garment branding may be approximate and non-readable, but it must be present in the correct location when the product reference shows it.
If a model appears, make the person realistic, fashion-editorial, and natural. Avoid uncanny faces, extra limbs, distorted hands, fake typography, or generic fashion-ad styling.
If this is a process/detail concept, make it tactile and art-directed: pencil marks, brush strokes, canvas grain, screenshots, scanner light, table shadows, paper edges, or studio evidence.
Aesthetic: minimal, premium, art-first streetwear; archival reconstruction; near-black, bone/off-white, muted grey-brown, deep oxidized red accents; concrete, metal, glass, studio, gallery, or city textures.
No readable text. No fake brand names. No neon cyberpunk. No glossy gradients. No sticker collage.

Post id: launch-recovery-03-product-clarity
Format: Solo Image Post
Pillar: Product
Hook: The garment is the object.
Caption: Product clarity after the origin story: the artwork becomes something wearable.
Source files: Distressed Grommet Eyelet Tank Top-mockups-1.png, Distressed Grommet Eyelet Tank Top-mockups-2.png
Reviewer direction: Make a visually appealing main image that helps tie this post into the curated feed.

Brief to follow:
### Concept Title
Tight Crop / Hard Light

### Use Case
AI model-shoot direction for a product clarity feed post.

### Image Prompt
Realistic editorial fashion photo of a female model wearing the distressed grommet eyelet tank top, styled minimal and monochrome to keep the garment dominant. Tight crop from collarbone to waist, clean front-facing pose, subtle tension in the fabric, strong visibility of eyelets and distressing. Dark neutral studio backdrop, hard side light, crisp shadow edges, premium magazine finish, high contrast, no extra props, garment reads as the object.

### Negative Prompt
Illustration, painterly look, extra garments, loud accessories, busy background, text, watermark, overstyled makeup, exaggerated pose, fantasy styling, distorted anatomy, opaque fabric hiding details.

### Styling Notes
- Keep the tank top as the focal point.
- Use neutral bottoms only if visible.
- Minimal jewelry, clean skin, slick hair.
- Frame for fabric texture + hardware clarity.
- Avoid white space in composition; fill frame.

### Feed Role
Hero product image; commercial anchor after the origin-story content.

### Source Assets To Respect
- Distressed Grommet Eyelet Tank Top-mockups-1.png
- Distressed Grommet Eyelet Tank Top-mockups-2.png
